proposed_widenings.name: random_outcome_payload
proposed_widenings.justification: A single random-table branch needs to release heterogeneous payloads: referenced spell casts, local timed effects, summons, and object exile. The current random_table shape can only branch into ActivationPhase arrays, which cannot host those full payloads honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: That location becomes the point of origin of a spell or other magical effect determined by rolling on the Wand of Wonder Effects table.

proposed_widenings.name: RandomTableOutcome.spell_cast
proposed_widenings.justification: Several rows are immediate casts of existing spells with wand-defined DC/range/origin overrides. grant_spell_access is a persistent grant, not an immediate random resolution.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You cast a spell originating from the chosen point.

proposed_widenings.name: random_outcome_branch_duration
proposed_widenings.justification: Different branches have distinct local durations and repeat-save behavior, but activated magic items only carry one shared top-level duration, not branch-local lifecycle.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn

proposed_widenings.name: uncontrolled_spawned_creature
proposed_widenings.justification: The current spawned-creature surface assumes a controllable companion. This item creates a creature that is explicitly not under the user's control.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature isn't under your control, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points.

proposed_widenings.name: object_target_attachment
proposed_widenings.justification: One branch targets an unattended object rather than a creature/self/area and exiles it to the Ethereal Plane. Activation-phase attachments do not currently admit object targets.
proposed_widenings.evidence: An object of the GM's choice disappears into the Ethereal Plane.

notes: Stopped before authoring. The item shell fits, but the random table forces cross-family composition that the current magic-item activation surface cannot express honestly.
